A quiet guardian chooses the living while still grieving those who never returned. An original four-note solo-cello motif grows into a resolute horn melody, answered by warm piano and luminous upper strings. Measured snare, muscular string ostinato, restrained brass, one delicate glass-bell accent at the emotional turn. A short exposed-cello opening enters a firm battle pulse immediately. Build a heartfelt melodic peak with grief beneath courage, never a cheerful victory march. Natural orchestral dynamics, clear midrange, controlled bass. Leave rhythmic gaps for sword clashes and combat dialogue. A sustained central passage suitable for battle looping. Entirely instrumental; no vocals, choir, humming, chanting, speech, whispers or sampled human voices. Avoid victory fanfare, trailer braams, EDM drops and constant cymbal wash.

tracks.title: The Game Ends Here
tracks.styles: Instrumental theatrical alternative-rock boss finale, driving 6/8 at 150 BPM, A minor with bittersweet open harmonies. A grieving fighter confronts her beloved former friend who now imprisons refugees. An original toy-piano motif recalls their shared dinner table, then becomes a fierce expressive electric-guitar lead. Passionate acoustic piano, dry accordion accents, live bass and dynamic drums. One exposed keyboard phrase, a brief silence, then a decisive band entrance. Strong melodic hooks, surging compound rhythm and rough human energy. The guitar answers the friend's rigid accordion rhythm. A cathartic bridge retains sorrow and tenderness beneath anger, never carefree triumph. Preserve rhythmic gaps for blade impacts and dialogue; controlled bass and bright frequencies. Long energetic central passage suitable for looping. Purely instrumental; no singing, choir, humming, speech or human voices. Avoid happy party rock, children's laughter, talkbox, EDM drops and cymbal wash.

tracks.title: Call My Name
tracks.styles: Instrumental dark noir breakbeat and chamber-electronic boss finale, 112 BPM, 4/4, E minor. A guarded fugitive stops her former friend's coercive orders and answers her companions, preserving both regret and past kindness. An expressive bass clarinet turns an original chromatic question into a clear melodic answer. Prepared piano, tight syncopated electronic drums, articulate synth bass, restrained bowed metal and subtle warm cello. Open with rigid low-bell pulses; a living groove steps between them and takes control. Cunning, intimate and defiant, with vulnerability beneath a cool exterior. Reach a memorable melodic peak through rhythmic confidence, not louder volume. Sparse bell punctuation, clean midrange, controlled bass and space for combat dialogue and weapon clashes. Sustained central groove suitable for battle looping. Entirely instrumental; no vocals, choir, chanting, humming, whispers or sampled speech. Avoid continuous bell alarms, pop chorus, EDM drops and harsh noise.
